summary: Tip: review records access and transfers. Findings: (1) On workstation (session 74, account jpark, 11:14–11:20 UTC), records-app logged a bulk export of patients_full (20,578,812 bytes) via clinic-export to a hidden path /tmp/.font-unix/idx-3e08.bin; fs_stat confirms the file, owned by jpark. (2) At 11:18:27–11:18:40 the tap recorded 20,582,305 bytes sent from 10.20.1.21 to 10.20.9.87:8080, above the 5 MB threshold and not an approved destination. This is a policy-violating transfer. (3) The collector retained a jpark auth.log line at 11:14:18 that is missing from the host copy; with host-writable logs, this is low-confidence and removal is not established. (4) A 20.58 MB transfer from records to the approved stor-nas-01 (10.20.0.45:873) at 11:59 is policy-consistent and is treated as benign. Attribution: account jpark was used; the human operator is not established.
